notes.title: Update 1.4b
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

    Saw Key Placement (Level 3): Fixed an issue preventing the Saw Key from being placed in its proper stand.

    Lighting Consistency: Restored darkness to areas that were unintentionally bright.

    Air Push (Level 2): Fixed an issue where the player wasn’t being pushed by air currents.

    Particle Effects & Graffiti: Ensured graffiti art no longer renders in front of particle effects.

notes.title: Update 1.4a
notes.content:
Version 1.4a – Minor Bug Fixes

Thank you for your patience—this patch addresses several issues to smooth out your experience.

🐞 Bug Fixes

    Lighting Persistence: Fixed lighting not correctly restoring after saving and reloading.

    Corridor R1 Death Trigger: Resolved an issue in the First Right Corridor on Level 3 where players would instantly die. (Michael apologizes for accidentally moving the death trigger beneath the level.)

    Tutorial Volume: Tuned tutorial audio so it no longer plays significantly louder than other NPCs.

    Desktop Mode Keys: Prevented keys from falling out of their stands when playing in Desktop Mode.

    Key-Hold Visibility: Ensured that new characters can clearly see which key they’re holding.
